findings: task_locate_ldt own unsigned range checks use wrapped base+size; no own nonzero, carry, 8-byte alignment, size20-bit limit, descriptor contents, or pin/map operation before storing K base/size. Actual allowed caller/map states unresolved.

Setters hold task then lock_write(K+0x10), publish K base/size before task_dowait(A,1), iterate T with reference before releasing task spinlock, copy into P+74/78, immediately program GDT and LLDT if active T, then release task before lock_done. Own results after task_hold not propagated.
Six exported LLDT sites found and raw checked; all source operand WORD [0x1d14ea]. File selector20; no exhaustive runtime const writer proof.

Every selected LDT descriptor pack splits full base; limit=(size-1)&fffff; clears G bit but preserves old flags70 and DPL bits in old access&e0|82. Zero size underflows and large size truncates arithmetically; no actual fault/exploit claim.

switch_context/stack_handoff compare both P base and size before LLDT; thread_bootstrap_return compares base only and skips updating size/LLDT on same base; initial context always programs. Descriptor contents with unchanged base/size not compared.

task_hold and task_dowait exclude active T, task_release iterates all T; thread_release decrements T+40 unconditionally. Local current-thread decrement not balanced by these hold calls if current T is in list; whole caller invariant unresolved.
thread_dowait low-nibble table sends6 to rem_runq,7/b/e/f to sleep,others to exit; must_wait1 suppresses own interrupted return5 path. Queue/sleep/halt semantics not proved from local table.

stack_handoff C returns in_CR0|8 but raw writes CR0; conditional CR3 writes absent from C. switch_context/start_initial_context C omit CR0/CR3 writes. LLDT/LTR C immediates are folds of file WORD sources.
Bootstrap optional TSS resize/copy path also raw decoded; full allocation/bitmap offset/sentinel and error cleanup contracts remain open.
